title: MATest compression frame with specimen and wires
objects_and_counts: One vertical compression test frame with a visible metal badge reading 'MATEST' at the top center of the frame.
One specimen: a rectangular beige block (appears to be wood or similar) placed centrally between the platens; the block has handwritten text on its front face.
Two round black platens are visible: one upper platen (partly obscured by a yellow triangular marker) and one lower platen supporting the specimen.
At least five wires are visible entering the scene from the specimen area: multiple red insulated wires and one white insulated wire; the exact total is uncertain due to overlap and cropping.
One small yellow triangular marker attached to the black upper assembly above the specimen.
One clear hinged door/panel on the left side of the machine (transparent plastic or acrylic) with metal hinges and latches visible.
One small yellow rectangular label near the bottom front of the machine with the text 'MIN' visible.
One metal cabinet or bench visible to the left of the test frame and lab tubing and/or hoses visible to the right of the frame.
spatial_relations: The specimen block is centered vertically between the upper and lower round platens; the lower platen supports the specimen and the upper platen is immediately above it.
The yellow triangular marker is attached to the black upper assembly and points downward toward the specimen.
Several wires extend from the front face of the specimen and hang down over the front of the lower platen and the machine base.
A transparent hinged door/panel is mounted on the left side of the frame; its hinges and latch are visible at the left edge of the machine.
A metal cabinet or bench is located to the left of the machine outside the frame, while tubing and a sink or plumbing fixtures appear to be to the right of the machine.
colours_and_materials: The test frame exterior is dark blue painted metal.
The platens and some cylindrical internal components are black and appear metallic.
Wires seen are primarily red insulated conductors and at least one white insulated conductor.
The hinged door/panel is transparent (clear) plastic or acrylic with metal hinges.
The small rectangular label near the base is yellow with black text.
uncertainties: Exact count of wires is uncertain because several wires overlap and are partially obscured; at least five wires (multiple red, one white) are visible but there may be more behind them.
Material identifications (for example 'wood' for the specimen or 'metal' for platens) are visual impressions and not confirmed by legible model/specification labels.
Small or partially visible text beyond 'MATEST', '1A(LP)' and 'MIN' is present but unreadable in this image; close-up crops would be needed to capture any additional label text or serial numbers.
No explicit room name or number is visible in the image; therefore location is listed as unknown from image.
